name: Breadcrumbs
summary: Trail that shows where the page sits in the structure, with links to the levels above it.
use: Pages that are three or more levels deep.
avoid: Flat sites with one or two levels.
As a replacement for the main navigation.
figmaProps: Turns a level on or off, including its separator.
Change the labels of the levels in the properties panel.
reactProps: The last item is the current page.
Screen reader name of the home link. Default 'Home'.
Back link before the trail. Default label 'Back'.
Text of the back link when back.label is not set. Default 'Back'.
behaviour: Items are links. The last item is not.
a11y: <nav> with an aria-label. Current page with aria-current="page".
content: Use the page titles, made shorter where needed.
do: On mobile, shorten long paths to the level above.
dont: The current page as a link.
open: Shortening on small screens is not built in yet.
